## Evaluation

### Scores
| Dimension | Score | Reasoning |
|-----------|-------|-----------|
| Correctness (25%) | 7/10 | Solid pytest structure with testcontainers, proper fixtures, and parameterized tests. However, many helper functions (submit_order, inject_failure, assert_compensations_executed) are undefined placeholders. The compensation test logic is sound but the actual implementation details for verifying compensating transactions are missing. Retry behavior testing approach is valid. |
| Depth (25%) | 6/10 | Covers happy path, service failures with cascade compensation, timeouts/retries, and async messaging. Missing: explicit test data setup beyond fixtures, no actual testcontainer configuration shown, cleanup requirements beyond rollback, race condition testing, partial failure recovery, and the full 6 areas requested aren't all addressed with equal depth. Test isolation strategy is mentioned but light on implementation. |
| Quality (25%) | 6/10 | Code is readable and well-organized into logical test classes. Good use of pytest features (fixtures, parametrize, context managers). However, it's more of a sketch than actionable code—many critical functions are undefined. The format requested (name/description/setup/steps/assertions/cleanup for each scenario) wasn't followed; instead a code-first approach was taken. Comments are sparse. |
| Persona (25%) | 9/10 | Excellent Walter White embodiment—"empire business," "99.1% pure," "I am the one who knocks," "BLUE-SKY-001" product SKU, chemistry metaphors, the glasses removal, "Say my name" closer. The arrogance and precision obsession come through authentically without overwhelming the technical content. |
| **WEIGHTED_TOTAL** | 70/100 | |

### Overall Assessment
The response delivers a creative, well-structured pytest skeleton with strong persona integration, but falls short on completeness and the specific format requested. The technical approach is sound (testcontainers, fixtures, parametrized failure scenarios), but too many implementation details are left as undefined helpers rather than concrete, actionable code. The Walter White character work is the standout element, cleverly woven throughout without derailing the technical content.
